US1 fairlead (+ its eye and box hanging below)

assumptions: US-TOPO: the strap lies on B-01's frame face between the bag and the frame; where a fairlead or the HE stands proud of its line it rides over it (the bag face gives, the strap is the tension member); settled by HE-FIT step 0 on the US test piece and by FIT-US on P1
US-FLEET: an eye in its 20 mm throat takes <= 10 deg out of the stay plane; settled by HE-FIT step 0
SIM_TORSO (h1_sleeve): every crown-kit end maps to the 15 / 19 / 23 in drape; the fairleads are on the fixed stays, so a kit or torso change moves only the bag

DRAPE-TENT: the drapes have no fairleads in the frame contact (B-01 is not tented by the cheek tips there); the lane check measures the strap ribbon against the print in 3D, so a tent can only lift the strap away from it

corner_keepers.choice: (a) channel ends at the lane x: no concentrated load on the floor; US2's channel then runs past F-02 onto B-05 (seam-sealed stitch line). (b) is the fallback if the floor must not be stitched.
